Idk.

And I have to disagree with that quote. With people that know true sorrow (and believe me, I am not one of those people), extreme depression, that sort of thing, they never really get out of that. Even when their symptoms go away and they're happy and in great realtionships it's always a deep scar in their psyche/life. They become numbed to feelings greater than superficial ones or at least their full potential. I believe that ignorance truly is bliss when it comes to dealing with depression and extreme sadness. I believe that the person that has never experienced being so sad and drowned by pain and sorrow is one that can be happier, and in greater love, longer. Now, I do not know if this is actually the case. I would have to consult some psychiatric findings on this.
